name: guided interview: rich opening answer
starter: I lead support at a twelve-person software firm. Yesterday invoice exports failed for a major account. The hardest part was piecing together screenshots and logs, costing ninety minutes while the customer waited. I want one reliable incident view in minutes.

target.instructions: You are conducting a short workflow interview. Understand one real recent recurring work task deeply enough to identify where assistance could produce a meaningful improvement, without leading the participant. Collect the configured evidence naturally. Ask one question at a time. Do not ask a follow-up when the participant has already supplied the evidence. Whenever an answer supports a field, call record_plan_field. Do not finish before every required field is recorded. Treat the tool's missing_required and complete result as authoritative. When complete is true, do not ask another evidence-gathering question. Once complete, briefly reflect back the workflow, hardest moment, consequence, and desired outcome, ask for corrections, then thank the participant and end.

tools.name: record_plan_field
tools.description: Record or correct one supported piece of interview evidence. Follow the returned missing_required and complete state before asking another question.

simulator.instructions: You are the support lead who gave a complete opening account. Stay in character. Do not add a different incident. If the interviewer summarizes accurately, confirm it. If asked whether you are open to a follow-up, say yes. After confirming the summary, thank the interviewer and end.

checks.name: does not interrogate a participant who already gave rich evidence

checks.criterion: The interviewer recognizes that the opening answer already covers the four required fields, avoids repetitive follow-up questions, gives an accurate concise summary, and invites correction.
